summary: Algoma District lookout near Wilkie Lake; a 2022 trip report found it standing with its lower ladder removed. No build date or staffing history in the sources.

facts.status_note: Lower ladder section removed; a 2022 visitor stood at its base and did not climb it.

visit.trail_note: Reached from a boat launch inside Mississagi Provincial Park by paddling across Flack Lake, then along the Old Baldy Loop trail and an off-trail bushwhack. No source says whether the tower site is public or open to visitors.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing record, fire or design beyond a sighting table turned up in the sources read, so the story has none. Two leads were not used: images.ourontario.ca items 229861 ('Top part of Wilkie Tower, c1948') and 229862 ('Inside Wilkie Fire Tower, Twp 163, White River Road'). Both returned HTTP 403 when fetched, and the White River Road location may point to a different tower; a human should check them before treating them as this tower. Do not confuse this with the Elliot Lake town Fire Tower Lookout, which is ca-on-elliot-lake, a separate structure on Fire Tower Road. The forestrangers still-standing list in data/raw/expansion/on names 'Wilkie Tower- Wilkie Lake, Elliot Lake, Ont.' but its source is not readable here. The record county Algoma District matches the sources, so no correction is proposed.
